# A.G Diagnostics - Best Diagnostic Centre
> A.G Diagnostics is a diagnostic and pathology healthcare provider offering blood tests, pathology services, preventive health checkups, diagnostic packages, and home sample collection services. Established in 1978, A.G Diagnostics operates a diagnostic network with a strong presence in Pune and services in Ahmednagar. The website is built using React and provides location-specific diagnostic information, test packages, health checkups, and healthcare resources.

## Main Website
- [A.G Diagnostics](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/): Official website of A.G Diagnostics, providing diagnostic tests, pathology services, health checkups, preventive packages, home sample collection, and healthcare information.
- [About A.G Diagnostics](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/about-us): Information about A.G Diagnostics, its diagnostic services, healthcare approach, and legacy.
- [About Founder - Dr. Ajit Golwilkar](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/about-us/about-founder): Information about Dr. Ajit Golwilkar and the history and legacy of A.G Diagnostics.
- [Our Team](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/about-us/our-team): Information about the doctors, pathologists, microbiologists, and technical team at A.G Diagnostics.
- [Home Sample Collection](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/home-visit): Home sample collection service for booking diagnostic tests and blood sample collection at the patient's location.
- [Blogs](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/blogs/): Healthcare articles covering blood tests, health checkups, preventive healthcare, home sample collection, thyroid health, kidney health, women's health, and other diagnostic topics.

## A.G Diagnostics Highlights
- **Trusted Legacy:** 4 decades of trusted legacy by Dr. Ajit Golwilkar.
- **State-of-the-Art Laboratory:** State-of-the-art pathology laboratory and diagnostic centre spread across 16,000 sq. ft.
- **Collection Centres:** 55+ collection centres across Pune.
- **Home Sample Collection:** Home sample collection services available at your doorstep.
- **NABL Accreditation:** NABL accredited as per ISO 15189:2022 standards.

## Pune
- [A.G Diagnostics Pune](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/): Main A.G Diagnostics website and diagnostic centre information for Pune.
- [Pune Health Checkup Packages](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/packages): Preventive and comprehensive health checkup packages available through A.G Diagnostics in Pune.
- [Pune Home Sample Collection](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/home-visit): Home blood sample collection and diagnostic testing services available across Pune and PCMC.
- [AG-Care Basic - Pune](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/package-details/ag-care-basic): Preventive health package including hemogram, fasting blood sugar, cholesterol, triglycerides, SGPT, kidney function, TSH, and urine testing.
- [AG-Care Holistic Plus - Pune](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/package-details/ag-care-holistic-plus): Comprehensive health checkup package covering blood, liver, kidney, lipid, thyroid, vitamin, mineral, and urine investigations.
- [AG-Care Master Comprehensive Advance - Pune](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/package-details/ag-care-master-comprehensive-advance): Advanced comprehensive health checkup package with blood tests, HbA1c, lipid profile, thyroid tests, vitamin tests, ECG, X-ray, ultrasound, and 2D Echo.
- [AG-Care Madam Comprehensive - Pune](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/package-details/ag-care-madam-comprehensive): Comprehensive women's health checkup package including blood tests, thyroid testing, vitamin testing, ECG, X-ray, ultrasound, PAP smear, and gynecological checkup.
- [AG-Care Master Longevity Package - Pune](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/package-details/ag-care-master-longevity-package): Advanced wellness and longevity package covering metabolic, hormonal, vitamin, liver, kidney, lipid, thyroid, and other health markers.
- [AG-Care Aller-T Basic - Pune](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/package-details/ag-care-aller-t-basic): Allergy-focused diagnostic package including routine health investigations and Phadiatop Screening IgE.
- [AG-Care Occusafe - Pune](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/package-details/ag-care-occusafe): Occupational health package focused on heavy metal testing including arsenic, cadmium, chromium, lead, mercury, nickel, selenium, zinc, and other elements.

## Diagnostic Services
- [Home Sample Collection](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/home-visit): Blood and diagnostic sample collection from the patient's home through trained phlebotomists.
- [Health Checkup Packages](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/packages): Preventive and comprehensive diagnostic health checkup packages.
- [Blood Tests](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/package-details/ag-care-basic): Blood testing and routine health investigations including CBC/hemogram, blood sugar, cholesterol, liver, kidney, thyroid, and urine tests.
- [Pathology Services](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/): Clinical pathology, hematology, clinical biochemistry, microbiology, histopathology, and cytopathology services.
- [Preventive Healthcare](https://www.agdiagnostics.com/pune/packages): Preventive health screening and wellness packages designed for different health and lifestyle requirements.
